records.text: Pastor Russell Johnson warned against talking-head personalities who peddle conspiracy theories for clicks and money and against podcasters he accused of monetizing tragedy, depressing people, dividing the movement, and obstructing its work.
records.speaker: Russell Johnson

appearances.snippet: Beware of talking-head personalities who peddle conspiracy theories to their room-temperature-IQ audiences in hopes of generating a few more clicks and a few more dollars for their narcissistic pseudo-empires. ... Beware of modern-day Ahabs and Jezebels who sit behind microphones in air-conditioned studios, running their podcasts, monetizing tragedy, attempting to depress the people, divide the movement, and stop us from building in this unprecedented era of opportunity.
